product_overview: DeelRxCRM is a mobile-first CRM, POS, and inventory management system tailored for regulated, inventory-driven small businesses, emphasizing financial accuracy, compliance, and operational speed on mobile devices.
core_goals: Ensure financial accuracy and auditability in all transactions and inventory movements.
Maintain strict role-based access control enforced at the server/database level.
Provide fast, mobile-optimized sales workflows with immutable transaction records.
Enable precise inventory management with traceability of quantities, weights, and costs.
Support configurable pricing and tax rules per business, with deterministic logic and consistent rounding.
Allow customer profiling that supports basic details, purchase histories, and soft-disable features.
Generate comprehensive reports and append-only audit logs covering critical system activities.
Ensure system use is intuitive enough for new staff to perform sales quickly and accurately.
key_features: Mobile-optimized POS system supporting fractional quantity sales, price overrides with role validation, and tax configurations.
Inventory management API tracking quantity, weight, and derived cost per unit with immutable historical records and adjustment logs.
Credit system for managing customer credit lines and balances.
AI insights endpoints to provide business analytics and insights with controlled integration.
Admin and team management APIs for managing users, permissions, and system configuration with audit logging.
Notification system to alert users of important events and system statuses.
Comprehensive reporting suite covering sales, inventory movements, taxes, and user actions with append-only audit logs.
user_flow_summary: Cashier logs in and completes sales using the mobile-optimized POS interface, viewing products and customers but unable to modify sensitive settings.
Supervisors can override prices within allowed bounds, void transactions, and adjust inventory quantities with audit trails.
Managers manage product pricing, tax settings, customer and supplier data while accessing detailed reports and analytics.
Super Admins configure the system globally, manage users and roles, and access full audit logs and system diagnostics.
Inventory intake is recorded with total cost, weight, and delivery costs; adjustments are logged as new immutable records.
Sales and system actions generate immutable transaction records and audit logs ensuring full traceability.
validation_criteria: All sensitive financial changes and inventory adjustments must generate unmodifiable audit logs.
Role-based permissions must enforce access control at the server/database layer, not relying on UI restrictions.
POS transactions are immutable after completion; corrections require void/refund workflows with audit trails.
Historical inventory and financial data must not be silently mutated and remain trustworthy.
New users can complete a sale in under two minutes using the mobile interface.
Tax and pricing logic must be deterministic, reproducible, and consistent with configured rounding rules.
Audit logs must be append-only and cover all critical system activities including overrides, voids, refunds, and permission changes.
